context.text: Kalimera Priya! Ten pages of Dune on the couch at 7 tonight. You in?

transcript.text: Love it, Priya! That's two days down, and tonight makes three. Go get lost in Arrakis. 📖
btw is it weird that I skip the appendices

Not weird at all. The appendices are bonus material, and plenty of readers skip them or save them for after the story. Your plan is the 10 pages of story tonight. Are you excited for where you are in Dune?
Sounds like a heavy day, Priya. Ten pages at 7 still fits, even if you're fried by then. It's about 20 minutes on the couch, and it can be your wind-down. Think you can still make it happen tonight?
omg my boss just asked me to stay late, can we do 8:30 instead?
Done, 8:30 tonight it is, Priya. Same 10 pages on the couch, so get through the late stretch at work and then it's you and Dune. Send me a photo of the page you stop on. 💪
Sounds good. Good luck with the late stretch, Priya. Dune will be waiting at 8:30. 📖
8:30 tonight, Priya. Ten pages on the couch, then a photo of the page you stop on. 📖
